title: Effective dynamics of the Sinkhorn algorithm in the regime of low entropy regularization
summary: The Sinkhorn algorithm is the de facto standard method for numerically solving entropy-regularized optimal transport problems over finite sets. In this work, we investigate a phenomenon arising when Sinkhorn is applied with a small regularization parameter $τ$: the evolution of the dual variables (the logarithm of the scaling factors) is approximately piecewise-linear, while the primal variables (the approximate transport plans) exhibit a saddle-to-saddle type behavior.
